cuts.placeText: a construction site — a crane, orange cones, a pile of rubble, a half-built wall and a cement mixer
cuts.scene: she is an operator standing with her hands folded beside the cement mixer, waiting for the next dig to start
cuts.outfit: a construction operator look fitted to her body — a fitted sleeveless hi-vis vest over a tank top and short work shorts with boots, bare shoulders and legs, a horn-shaped helmet sticker
